blocks.text: Today, you will experience a unique adventure – swimming with nurse sharks at the Hol Chan Marine Reserve. The name of the marine park, Hol Chan, comes from the Maya language and means "little channel." The Great Blue Hole and the Hol Chan Marine Reserve are must-see attractions on Ambergris Caye. The Blue Hole is a circular limestone sinkhole, with a depth of 122 meters. Here, you'll have an unforgettable dive in the ultramarine waters, where you’ll encounter various species of sharks, hammerhead fish, and colorful coral reef fish. Hol Chan, with a depth of up to 30 meters, is home to over 150 species of exotic fish, 40 varieties of corals, as well as sea turtles and sharks.
